title: Invariant Composition
description: A theorem-level visual composition pack for transformation-invariance, carrier transfer, causal memory, derivative-aware trajectories, modality counterpoint, conservation laws, semantic transitions, recognition transactions, and post-climax assimilation.

assets.description: A parametrically lobed continuity contour whose relational signature remains measurable across scale, rotation, reflection and material changes.
provenance: Forest transmission: five-lobed seed as conserved operator, generalized beyond one composition

assets.description: A compact circular or linear signature encoding interval relations rather than literal shape, allowing identity to survive transformed appearances.
provenance: Fugue subject defined by fixed rhythmic-intervallic identity

assets.description: A family of transformed instances arranged around a shared invariant gauge, with position, scale, orientation and parity varied independently.
provenance: Transformation-invariant motif identity across inversion, augmentation, diminution, transposition and retrograde

assets.description: A material carrier frame that can change between vessel, lattice, ribbon, wave and branch while preserving an embedded relational identity.
provenance: Migrating passacaglia: relational ground survives transfer between carriers

assets.description: A decaying history field computed from prior states rather than current values alone, exposing temporal memory and path dependence.
provenance: Causal-memory filter and history-dependent composition requirement

assets.description: A derivative-aware trajectory ribbon encoding current value, direction, velocity and acceleration as separate visual channels.
provenance: Six-dimensional state understood as six trajectories rather than six scalar values

assets.description: Three or four parallel modality lanes with independently offset events, showing proposal, complication, reorientation and completion without forced synchrony.
provenance: Music proposes, visual complicates, narration reorients, silence permits completion

assets.description: A continuously updated gauge comparing transformed geometry with a normalized relational signature, revealing preservation or rupture.
provenance: Conservation laws: conserved, transformable and forbidden properties

assets.description: A connectivity-preserving thread or graph that may bend, scale, nest and branch while retaining a declared adjacency invariant.
provenance: Continuity identity capable of topology change while preserving another invariant

assets.description: A transition glyph generated from a causal verb such as germinate, fracture, invert, entrain, unbind, condense or remember.
provenance: Transitions treated as semantic scenes rather than generic packaging

assets.description: A cross-modal density allocator showing how visual, musical and verbal complexity trade against one another under a finite attention budget.
provenance: Maximum density in every medium produces minimum comprehension

assets.description: A field that gradually stops responding to material appearance and begins responding to the conserved relational signature.
provenance: Recognition transaction designed backward from what must become directly available

mechanisms.description: One relational identity undergoes rotation, scaling, reflection and deformation while a normalized signature remains stable.
mechanisms.motionProof: Appearance changes continuously while the invariant gauge stays stable, making persistence inferable without literal repetition.
provenance: Relational fugue subject and transformable five-lobed seed

mechanisms.description: A conserved relational signature migrates through materially different carriers without any single carrier remaining permanent.
mechanisms.motionProof: The original carrier withdraws before a different carrier completes the same relation, proving persistence through transfer rather than hidden material continuity.
provenance: Migrating passacaglia and carrier-turnover thesis

mechanisms.description: Current state and decaying history diverge, so identical present values produce different appearances depending on the path taken.
mechanisms.motionProof: The trace persists after the driving state reverses, demonstrating memory as history-dependent dynamics rather than a static memory icon.
provenance: dm/dt = (d-m)/tau and the requirement that the same state render differently by history

mechanisms.description: A behavioral state is shown together with velocity and acceleration, distinguishing rising, falling, accelerating and held conditions at equal values.
mechanisms.motionProof: The marker can occupy the same value while ribbon direction and curvature differ, proving that trajectory carries information absent from a scalar state.
provenance: u_state and u_dState separation

mechanisms.description: Music, image and narration follow related but offset trajectories so each modality has independent causal agency.
mechanisms.motionProof: Related events enter in different lanes at different times and only later align, demonstrating designed anticipation and semantic delay.
provenance: Music proposes; visual complicates; narration reorients; completion follows

mechanisms.description: Candidate transformations pass or fail according to declared conserved, transformable and forbidden properties.
mechanisms.motionProof: Permitted transformations continue through the gate while an identity-breaking substitution is visibly arrested and removed.
provenance: Transfer the evaluator that rejected weaker possibilities

mechanisms.description: A transition enacts a named causal law rather than crossfading between unrelated completed states.
mechanisms.motionProof: The outgoing geometry is materially reorganized into the incoming geometry by the selected verb, so the transition itself carries the explanation.
provenance: Transitions are semantic scenes

mechanisms.description: Several independent transformations carry one relational subject simultaneously without collapsing into unison.
mechanisms.motionProof: Independent voices preserve different transformations and phases of the same signature, making coordinated multiplicity visible.
provenance: Counterpoint enacts multiplicity rather than illustrating it

mechanisms.description: Perceptual emphasis shifts from the continuity object's changing material appearances to the relation that survived every change.
mechanisms.motionProof: Material carriers fade from emphasis while the invariant relation becomes the stable foreground, enacting recognition before explanatory language arrives.
provenance: Recognition transaction designed backward from the climax

mechanisms.description: A high-intensity recognition event is followed by a distinct assimilation phase in which the world remains transformed without sustaining the climax.
mechanisms.motionProof: The peak contracts while a persistent transformed relation remains, distinguishing the climax from the endpoint and avoiding automatic collapse.
provenance: Forest climax at 545–548 seconds and 52-second assimilation

mechanisms.description: Argument, music and image perform the same abstract causal relation through different materials without becoming redundant copies.
mechanisms.motionProof: Three lanes undergo matching source-to-target transformations with distinct marks and timings, proving shared structure without modal duplication.
provenance: Argument causal structure to musical form to visual world

mechanisms.description: Several formally plausible candidates are tested against causal necessity, invariant continuity and epistemic restraint before one survives.
mechanisms.motionProof: Candidates fail for different visible reasons rather than merely losing opacity, while the survivor remains because it satisfies all declared constraints.
provenance: The accumulated critic as the transferable state

selectionPolicy.captionPolicy: Labels name formal relations, invariants, derivatives or causal verbs; narration carries philosophical prose.
forbiddenLiteralizations: continuity object replaced by an unrelated symbol
generic crossfade where a causal transformation is required
all modalities peaking simultaneously without attention-budget justification
recognition represented only by brighter glow
ending collapsed to zero merely because the composition is finished
selectionPolicy.epistemicRule: Formal homology is an artistic comparison, not empirical proof that two domains are ontologically identical.
